name: workflow-manager
description: Quality-first, context-efficient workflow management with daily/work and simple/hard routing, confirmed plans, compaction recovery, and dynamic subagent orchestration.

interface.shortDescription: Classify work, gate hard plans, and protect reasoning quality.
interface.longDescription: A thin continuity and authorization layer: keeps Simple and Focused work local, reserves highest-model assessment and strict confirmation for genuinely Hard work, and preserves runtime identity, evidence, and compaction continuity.
defaultPrompt: Use $workflow-manager as a thin continuity and authorization layer; do not repeat host-native guidance.
Keep Simple/Focused local. Hard needs one critical signal or two strong groups including diagnosis, scope, or continuity.
Preserve acceptance. Correct once; for unknown, critical, or repeated failure use one highest-available model at max.
